scope: UI rendering, composer, selectors and real PTY acceptance
source_revision: Accompanying commit; no changes to evaluation criteria or citation/permission guards

checks: Unicode bracketed paste and enhanced Shift+Enter
Three to eight input rows with one composer/footer
Draft preservation across resize and model/mode dialogs
Live catalog, pagination, editable search, no-result state and cancel
Separately approved noisy LSP fixture, no stderr sentinel on terminal
Factual final overview with source citation and idle footer
Command does not start before explicit UI approval
PTY command output visible before exit
Instruction queued while command waits for human input
Human input delivered through focused PTY
Persisted order: terminal result, queued instruction, final response

limitations: One local fixture run is not a general model quality or latency benchmark.
The noisy language server is a controlled fixture, not validation of every LSP.
The test-specific context override is not saved to the user configuration.
Raw LSP stderr is deliberately discarded; only counters and state remain in memory.
